decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both entries express the intended sense, but the variety assignment is too categorical: Indonesian also uses benci, and Malaysian Malay also uses membenci. Presenting the bare versus prefixed forms as a reliable Indonesian–Malaysian contrast may mislead learners. The narrowed cue is acceptable, the sense is broadly correct, and similar is an appropriate relation. No false-friend contrast is established. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
